scenes.spec_quote: Reset has higher priority than enable and can occur even when not enabled.
hh, mm, and ss are two BCD (Binary-Coded Decimal) digits each for hours (01-12), minutes (00-59), and seconds (00-59).
Reset has higher priority than enable and can occur even when not enabled.
Reset is the active high synchronous signal that resets the clock to "12:00 AM."
The signal "pm" is asserted if the clock is PM, or is otherwise AM.
